unit.why: A homily delivered on the Sabbath before Shavuot about true yichus (lineage), illustrated by a mashal of a king and four painters; there is no narrated event involving the tzaddik or anyone else beyond the parable used inside the teaching.
unit.boundary_note: The teaching is self-contained, from (כג) to ודפח"ח. The next division (כד) is another saying.
